material_systems.name: Interior Adhesion Primer
material_systems.description: Water-based adhesion promoter for previously painted interior closet shelving. Bonds to glossy or failing existing coatings without full mechanical sanding. Used when existing paint shows adhesion failure or peeling.

products.notes: Water-based for low VOC. Bonds to glossy surfaces without full sanding. For SS_INT_FAILING_PAINT: spot prime scraped areas, full prime if bare >30%. For SS_INT_PEELING: full surface prime after scrape.

material_systems.name: Interior Stain-Block Primer
material_systems.description: Acrylic stain-blocking primer for moisture and smoke damage on closet shelving. Prevents stain bleed-through from water stains, mildew residue, and smoke/nicotine deposits. Acrylic (not shellac) is sufficient for closet shelving — utility surface does not require shellac-grade stain blocking.

products.notes: Acrylic stain-blocker is sufficient for closet shelving. Shellac (BIN) only needed for severe smoke damage on scrutinized surfaces (doors, trim) — closets do not warrant shellac premium. For SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE: apply after biocide treatment and 24hr dry. Full surface prime.

material_systems.name: Interior Mildew-Resistant Primer
material_systems.description: Mildew-resistant primer with added fungicide for closets prone to moisture. Applied after biocide treatment for long-term mildew prevention. Used when SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE with mildew history.

products.notes: Applied after biocide treatment and 24hr dry. Contains fungicide to prevent mildew regrowth under paint film. Full surface prime on all moisture-affected shelving. Alternative to SYS_PRIMER_STAINBLOCK_INT when mildew is the primary concern (Materials Manager selects based on contamination type).

material_systems.name: Standard Acrylic Enamel System
material_systems.description: Standard 100% acrylic enamel for closet shelving repaint. Cost-effective, durable for light use. Identical to NC system — same product, same coverage, same performance on previously painted substrate.

products.notes: Standard acrylic enamel for utility closet shelving. QT2=1 coat (economy). QT3=2 coats (standard). No interstage sanding between coats at QT2/QT3 for closet shelving.

coverage_profiles.notes: Previously painted surfaces absorb less primer than bare wood. Higher coverage than NC primer rates. Applies to adhesion and stain-block primers on closet shelving.
Same as NC coverage rate. Previously painted or freshly primed surface provides good coverage. Per-coat rate — multiply by coat count for total material.

consumables.name: Angled sash brush 2"
consumables.notes: 2" angled sash for detail work on shelves and cleats.

consumables.name: Mini roller 4" foam
consumables.notes: 4" foam mini roller for flat shelf surfaces.

consumables.name: Sandpaper 150 grit
consumables.notes: Primary degloss grit for RP closet shelving. Scuff sand existing paint for adhesion profile.

consumables.name: Sandpaper 120 grit
consumables.notes: Coarser grit for feathering edges of failing/peeling paint.

consumables.name: Tack cloth
consumables.notes: Dust removal after sanding before coating.

consumables.name: Canvas drop cloth 4x12
consumables.notes: Floor protection under closet opening. Reusable across closets.

consumables.name: Paintable acrylic caulk
consumables.notes: Caulk repair — replace failed sections only (15-30% typical in RP vs full caulk in NC).

consumables.name: Lightweight spackle
consumables.notes: Spot fill nail holes and minor defects.

consumables.name: TSP (Trisodium Phosphate) Cleaner
consumables.notes: Surface wash for decontamination. Removes hand oils, cleaning chemical residue. Diluted per manufacturer. Used when surfaces are dirty/greasy.

consumables.name: Liquid Sander / Deglosser
consumables.notes: Chemical degloss option for existing satin/semi-gloss finishes. Alternative to mechanical scuff sand. Rarely needed on closet shelves (usually flat/eggshell).

consumables.name: Mildewcide / Biocide Solution
consumables.notes: Biocide for mildew treatment. Apply to all affected surfaces, scrub, rinse, allow 24hr dry before priming. Bleach solution (1:3 ratio) or commercial mildewcide.

consumables.name: Cotton rags / shop towels
consumables.notes: TSP wash application, degloss wiping, general cleanup.

consumables.name: Putty knife 2"
consumables.notes: Spot fill and scrape/feather tool. Reusable.

consumables.name: Blue painter's tape 1.5"
consumables.notes: Edge masking at shelf-to-wall junction if needed. Minimal usage for closet shelving.

consumables.name: Paint tray liner (mini)
consumables.notes: Disposable liner for mini roller tray.

floor_workzone.notes: Single drop cloth per closet opening. Minimal protection footprint.

compatibility_rules.description: Mildew primer requires prior biocide treatment
compatibility_rules.requires: Biocide application (CON_MILDEWCIDE) + 24hr dry time before priming
compatibility_rules.notes: Mildew spores must be killed before sealing under primer. Priming over live mildew causes regrowth.

compatibility_rules.description: Stain-block primer for moisture damage requires biocide treatment first
compatibility_rules.requires: Biocide treatment if mildew present, then stain-block primer to seal water/tannin stains
compatibility_rules.notes: Stain-block prevents bleed-through but does not kill mildew spores.

compatibility_rules.description: Adhesion primer not needed for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT
compatibility_rules.notes: Sound paint with verified adhesion does not need primer. Direct finish coat application.
Economy tier — single coat for utility surface refresh.
Standard tier — two coats for complete coverage and durability.

compatibility_rules.description: Degloss required before all RP finishes
compatibility_rules.requires: Mechanical scuff sand (150 grit) or chemical degloss before finish coat application
compatibility_rules.notes: Existing paint surface must be profiled for adhesion regardless of substrate state.

compatibility_rules.description: Primer selection is mutually exclusive by substrate state
compatibility_rules.notes: Only one primer system is used per job: adhesion OR stain-block OR mildew. Never stack multiple primers on closet shelving.
